scope: Independent exact rational/model/metric checks, deep receipt replay and entropy boundary checks, original user chart comparison, and read-only renderer/UI inspection. Browser release and packaging evidence are reviewed separately.

exactRationalProof.method: Independent Python integer and Fraction arithmetic, no repository verification functions imported
exactRationalProof.chartReview: Independent direct visual transcription of all 19 inline diagrams; exact source/proof/evidence match. Prototype numbering follows diagram reading order.

results.check: ordinary unchanged complete pending and settled-history receipt replays
shooter unchanged complete pending and settled-history receipt replays
collector unchanged complete pending and settled-history receipt replays
Changed expanded reel hit count rejected
Production pending and settled reload use zero fresh entropy calls

deepReceiptReplay.reviewer: Independent math-audit sub-agent; both pending and last-history copies mutated for each rejection check.

entropyBoundary.reviewer: Independent math-audit sub-agent; captured production entropy injection for quota boundary and zero-entropy validation replay.

priorRawHybridReview.limits: Executed during the prior implementation review; current engine/types/paylines/model-schema bytes match that test. Catalogue builder and full replay tooling subsequently changed and the model was regenerated; their checks are represented by the fresh exact/replay reports, not this raw test.

readOnlyRuntimeInspection.paylineChart: All 19 paths independently transcribed directly from the inline 7/7/5 diagram rows and compared with source/proof/evidence; source SHA and one-/zero-based rows match. Prototype line numbers follow diagram reading order; no printed official numerals were visible.
renderer: All landed Shooter expansions replay before the optional ordered shots.
Recorded shot impacts update one cell or all five expanded reel cells, with whole-reel lock cue and persisted multipliers.
Golden numbered win paths use committed receipt line IDs and cells.
Coin waves finish all reveals before modifiers, new collector transfers, retained-only clear and repeat.
No production board/Space event calls renderer.skip.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.playerRules: BG and EN text both describe 19 longest left-to-right lines, Wild-only exception, multiple expanding Shooters, optional one-use Wild shots, repeated-hit doubling, bonus-wide sticky full reels and base reset, guaranteed marked coin reveals and terminal-only payout.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.saveMigration: Version 4 storage imports only settled old virtual-wallet balance/bet and immediately persists a new ledger; old pending receipts remain untouched and are not replayed under changed mathematics.
readOnlyRuntimeInspection.visualReview: Inspected the original club scene landscape/portrait contact sheet and actual focused column-lock renderer capture. Cream/black ink and restrained red/gold accents fit the active symbol and character illustrations; real Wild multipliers and lock cue are readable.

limits: 96.5% is the expected weighted paid return, not a lower bound on individual sessions.
The exact 19 paths and displayed payout brackets are sourced from user-supplied screenshots; no claim to proprietary commercial probabilities or certification.
Temporary independent audit scripts execute against the pinned sources and write generated evidence; no runtime code was changed by these reviewers.
